description: Use this when a person wants to ask a business on Bookatu about a trip or service, or ask it a question, instead of holding a time. It works only at a business that takes enquiries from assistants (its bookVia is enquiry, or get_business says it takes them); any other business answers ENQUIRIES_NOT_TAKEN with its booking page. Pass the person's own words as message, and people or dates only if they said them. Bookatu emails the person a 6-digit code and a link, and nothing reaches the business until they confirm. Do not use for booking a time that check_availability offers, or for health details.

business.description: The business: its bookatu.com link or its own domain on Bookatu, or its slug.

email.description: The person's own email address. They confirm the enquiry from it.

name.description: The person's name, as they gave it.

phone.description: The person's phone, E.164 or national format.

idempotencyKey.description: The same key and the same details for a retry of one enquiry; a new key for anything else.

message.description: The person's own words, as they said them.

people.description: How many people, only if the person said so.

preferredEnd.description: The last day the person said, YYYY-MM-DD, on or after the first day.

preferredStart.description: The first day the person said, YYYY-MM-DD.

serviceId.description: A service or trip from list_services. Leave it out for a general question.
